notes: Route one: «قال الزهري أخبرنا عن قبيصة بن ذؤيب» (Zuhri's own speech); the chain ends at Qabisa and the Prophet is not a link.

Abu Dawud's remark after the matn («قال أبو داود روى هذا الحديث ...») names six other transmitters of the same saying, all ending at Abu Hurayra: written as a variant group. The compiler himself is not written.
